description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 1616/18 of 24.08.2009 - Cad. Map No. 21001 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing changes to land parcel classifications, ownership status (State to Private), access road designations, and expunging particulars for various land parcels. The content is entirely focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
